amendments.before: Ðā nōmon hīe ðā lāc and twīfeald fēoh, and fōron tō Egypta lande tō Iosepe.
amendments.after: Ðā nōmon hīe ðā lāc and twīfeald feoh, and fōron tō Egypta lande tō Iosepe.
amendments.reason: Select printed feoh without inferred length (Cook47.5); supplied seolfrenne rather than an insufficiently supported material-genitive extension; actual taught ðȳ-lǣs-ðe spelling. Earlier recommendation that feoh was already productive was withdrawn after the actual register check.
